historical_programs.sql_template: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), dept_avg AS (SELECT department, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY department), subq1 AS (SELECT i.department, i.academic_year, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS subject_count_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.department = d.department), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso2 ON ata2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE ata2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata2.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%')) SELECT s1.department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.avg_subject_count, s1.subject_count_category, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.academic_year = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.department, s1.academic_year

WITH MathCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), Subjects2014FA AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column AS math_row_number, s14.SUBJECT_TITLE AS s14_SUBJECT_TITLE, s14.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s14.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s14.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s14.TOTAL_UNITS, s14.window_column AS s14_min_total_units_window, ROUND(mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS / NULLIF(s14.TOTAL_UNITS, 0), 2) AS Enrolled_Per_Unit FROM MathCourses AS mc JOIN Subjects2014FA AS s14 ON mc.SUBJECT_ID = s14.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY Enrolled_Per_Unit DESC

WITH MathCourses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), Subjects2014FA AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT mc.COURSE_NUMBER, mc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mc.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, mc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mc.window_column AS math_window_column, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS TOTAL_UNITS, NULL AS subj_window_column FROM MathCourses AS mc UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS COURSE_NUMBER, s2014.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS math_window_column, s2014.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2014.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2014.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2014.TOTAL_UNITS, s2014.window_column AS subj_window_column FROM Subjects2014FA AS s2014) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100), subq1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0), subq2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_enrolled, s1.num_unique_subjects, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID
